```python
import pytest
import jinja2

def add_two(x, y):
    return [i + y for i in x]

def test_async_filter_subscriptable_error():
    env = jinja2.Environment(enable_async=True)
    env.filters.update({'add_two': add_two})
    template = env.from_string(\"{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}\")
    
    data = {'a': {'b': [1, 2, 3]}}
    
    # Catch any exception to inspect it
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as excinfo:
        template.render(data)
    
    # Now check if it's the expected TypeError
    assert isinstance(excinfo.value, TypeError)
    assert \"'coroutine' object is not subscriptable\" in str(excinfo.value)
```
